items.quote: We attempted to clean our own carpet and made a mess of it... totally soap and water saturated and still not clean. Ken came over 3 times to re-clean and treat the carpet. He was very punctual and the rug looks so much better! Ken even offered to help me bring all the furniture back in. Awesome.

items.quote: FANTASTIC SERVICE! I called on Tuesday to see if I could schedule a one-room cleaning and Kendra said they had time the next day. The soiled spots were gone, the rug was clean and the room smelled great!

about.title: Kept in the family since 1993
paragraphs: Kendra Thomas was born and raised in The Dalles. She took over her father Ben Bailey's business when he retired.
The business has stayed in the family: Kendra, her husband Ken and their children all work together to provide the utmost professional service.
We back our work with a 100% customer satisfaction guarantee. If you're not happy, we'll clean it a second time at no charge.

estimate.title: Book your cleaning.
estimate.text: Tell us what needs cleaning and we'll get back to you with a time and a free estimate. Carpet cleaning is 40¢ per sq ft with a $145 shop minimum.
estimate.thanks: We got your request and will reach out soon to get you on the schedule.

services.name: Carpet Steam Cleaning
services.blurb: Truck-mounted steam up to 230°: the cleanest, driest carpet possible.
services.intro: Our truck-mounted systems deliver up to 230 degrees of steam and powerful extraction, with Rotovac and Rx20 wands for the deepest clean.

services.name: Upholstery Cleaning
services.blurb: Sofas, love seats, recliners, sectionals and chairs.
services.intro: We steam clean your furniture to lift dirt, stains and odors.

services.name: Tile, Grout & Hard Floors
services.blurb: Tile and grout, LVT, LVP and linoleum.
services.intro: Hard floors hold onto dirt in the grout lines and texture. We get it out.

services.name: Area Rug Cleaning
services.blurb: Area rugs cleaned with pickup and drop-off.
services.intro: We pick up your area rugs, clean them and bring them back. Pricing varies by size.

services.name: Water, Fire & Smoke Restoration
services.blurb: Water extraction, sewer cleanup and fire and smoke restoration.
services.intro: When water, fire or smoke damage hits, call us fast. We extract the water and clean up the damage.
